description: Single maintained specification for BiteShark's highest-value shared backend/frontend/deployment contracts. Validated against live source symbols, HTTP routes, database tables, feature controls, and test files by `npm run registry:validate`.

contracts.title: Pinned PostgreSQL Transaction, Session Row-Locking & Local GUC Context
contracts.purpose: Pins a single pg.Client connection per transaction, enforces deterministic FOR SHARE locking on auth_users -> auth_sessions when governance session verification is active, scopes SET LOCAL app.* RLS GUCs, and clears verification state on commit/rollback.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: (dbAdapter, async fn(tx)) — acquires dedicated client via db.connect(), starts BEGIN, and if governance context sets requireEligibleSessionInTx, verifies active non-disabled 14+-eligible user and non-revoked session before executing fn(tx).
contracts.outputs: Promise resolving to the return value of fn(tx) after COMMIT (inferred per caller; plain JS).
contracts.errors: Throws SessionEligibilityError (401 SESSION_REVOKED / ACCOUNT_DISABLED or 403 AGE_ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED) after ROLLBACK when session/account state changed mid-flight; rethrows domain or pg errors after ROLLBACK.
contracts.side_effects: Executes BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK on a dedicated pg.Client; scopes all SET LOCAL / set_config(..., true) GUC mutations strictly to the transaction.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Mandatory foundation for all FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY mutations and live RBAC re-verification.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Prevents deadlocks by acquiring FOR SHARE locks in canonical order (auth_users before auth_sessions, before platform_roles / vendor_memberships / domain rows).
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Signature withTransaction(db, fn) and SessionEligibilityError properties (.status, .code) are stable cross-cutting invariants.
contracts.known_limitations: Read-only public catalog queries that do not set app.* GUCs may use pooled db.query directly; never call set_config(..., false) on an unpinned pool query.

contracts.title: Standalone Email OTP Sign-In, HttpOnly Session Cookie & CSRF Origin Verification
contracts.purpose: Manages passwordless 6-digit email OTP challenges (HMAC-SHA256), Resend HTTPS delivery, sliding HttpOnly session cookies (bs_session / __Host-bs_session), same-origin mutation CSRF checks, and sign-out cleanup.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: POST /api/auth/start validates normalized email, X-BiteShark-Auth-Client header, rate limits, staging recipient allowlist (when staging), and 14+ DOB on new-account signup without persisting raw DOB. POST /api/auth/verify validates 6-digit OTP and challenge attempt cap.
contracts.outputs: Validated JSON envelopes ({ ok, status, delivery_mode } on start; { ok, authenticated, user, requires_age_assessment } on verify/session) plus Set-Cookie headers.
contracts.errors: 400 validation errors, 403 CSRF_ORIGIN_DENIED / UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE / STAGING_RECIPIENT_RESTRICTED, 429 rate-limit responses with Retry-After, 503 delivery unavailability.
contracts.side_effects: Writes hashed OTP/session rows, records redacted auth_delivery_telemetry, dispatches Resend HTTPS email when BITESHARK_AUTH_DELIVERY_MODE=resend, and clears client-scoped caches on sign-out via biteshark:auth-signed-out.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS; /api/auth/staging-mailbox requires loopback/flag + operator mailbox secret; /api/admin/email-readiness is Admin: Top only.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: OTP consumption locks challenge row FOR UPDATE so a code can succeed at most once; logout revokes server session idempotently.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Cookie names, CSRF header/Origin semantics, and /api/auth/session user projection are shared across /, /login.html, and /admin.
contracts.known_limitations: Staging Resend mode intentionally restricts recipients to allowlisted emails/domains unless existing eligible staff/vendor account.

contracts.title: Minimum Account Age (14+ Pacific Civil Date) & Pending-Assessment Allowlist
contracts.purpose: Evaluates 14+ minimum account age in America/Los_Angeles civil calendar dates (with Feb 29 -> Mar 1 non-leap birthday rule), stores zero raw DOB fields, and blocks unassessed accounts outside the narrow governance allowlist.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Accepts { dob: 'YYYY-MM-DD' } or { dob_year, dob_month, dob_day }; validates real Gregorian date >= 1900 and not in the future in America/Los_Angeles.
contracts.outputs: Derived eligibility status ('eligible_14_plus' or 'ineligible_under_14') and AGE_POLICY_VERSION without echoing DOB.
contracts.errors: 403 AGE_ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED on gated endpoints while not_assessed; 403 UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE (disabling existing account and revoking sessions + setting cooldown cookie) when < 14.
contracts.side_effects: Persists only age_eligibility_status, age_assessed_at, and age_policy_version on auth_users; never logs or stores raw DOB.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Enforced centrally in server/app.js and inside withTransaction(verifySessionAndEligibilityInTx).
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Already-eligible accounts bypass reassessment; under-14 submission atomically disables account and revokes all active sessions.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: EXEMPT_GOVERNANCE_METHODS_BY_PATH must remain minimal (auth bootstrap, public stories/trails/features, invitation preview, and privacy/accessibility/account-access support tickets).
contracts.known_limitations: Proposed 14+ policy is marked pending formal legal counsel sign-off in compliance_readiness_items.

contracts.title: Five-Role RBAC, Row-Locked Tx Re-Verification, Act-on-Behalf & Audit Logging
contracts.purpose: Enforces Customer, Vendor Staff, Vendor Owner, Admin: Mod, and Admin: Top permissions, live row-locked re-verification inside transactions, Top-only Act-on-Behalf support reasons, and redacted audit_logs entries.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: reverify*InTx locks auth_users / platform_roles / vendor_memberships FOR SHARE (and vendors FOR NO KEY UPDATE when required); Act-on-Behalf requires X-BiteShark-Act-On-Behalf + 8-240 char X-BiteShark-Support-Reason from Admin: Top.
contracts.outputs: Structured { ok, actorRole, vendorId } or { ok: false, status, code, error } decision objects.
contracts.errors: 401 unauthenticated/revoked, 403 TOP_ADMIN_REQUIRED / ACT_ON_BEHALF_FORBIDDEN / SELF_ROLE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN / LAST_TOP_ADMIN_REQUIRED / vendor restriction errors.
contracts.side_effects: Appends immutable audit_logs rows (REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE enforced on runtime app role).
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Admin: Mod can triage/recommend but cannot grant roles, approve vendor onboarding finalization, or mutate feature controls; last eligible Admin: Top cannot be removed or suspended.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Uses pg_advisory_xact_lock('biteshark_platform_roles_mutation') and row locks to prevent concurrent last-Top removal races.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Role labels ('Admin: Top', 'Admin: Mod', 'Vendor Owner', 'Vendor Staff', 'Customer') and audit_logs immutability must be preserved.
contracts.known_limitations: api/favorites/toggle.js currently passes 'favorites' to isWritePaused (tracked in KNOWN-DRIFT.md).

contracts.title: Runtime Feature Controls DAG, HTTP Route Gate & Browser Sync
contracts.purpose: Governs runtime feature availability (enabled, paused, hidden) and audience (all, staff_beta) with cycle-free parent-child dependency propagation, optimistic revision concurrency, CLI break-glass recovery, and Cross-Tab BroadcastChannel sync.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: POST /api/admin/features/update requires Admin: Top, expected_revision (non-negative integer), valid allowed_states / allowed_audiences, 4-500 char reason, and confirm_interrupt=true on high-impact interrupts.
contracts.outputs: GET /api/features returns caller-safe effective states { ok: true, features } with zero internal reasons/actors; /api/admin/features adds revision, dependency graph, env overrides, and history.
contracts.errors: 503 FEATURE_PAUSED (when paused on mutation routes), 403 FEATURE_DISABLED (when hidden), 409 REVISION_CONFLICT on stale expected_revision, 503 fail-closed on corrupted persisted rows.
contracts.side_effects: Updates feature_controls, appends feature_control_history + audit_logs, and broadcasts biteshark_feature_controls_v1 across open browser tabs.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Public caller projection on GET /api/features; Admin: Mod or Top read on GET /api/admin/features; Admin: Top only on POST /api/admin/features/update (blocked during Viewpoint Preview).
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Optimistic concurrency via expected_revision + FOR UPDATE row lock; 0ms server-side cache ensures immediate enforcement across workers.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Disabling or hiding a feature never deletes underlying customer or vendor rows; self-service account export and deletion endpoints remain exempt.
contracts.known_limitations: Client UI checks via window.bitesharkFeatures are presentation-only; server routes must also register in ROUTE_FEATURE_ENFORCEMENT_RULES.

contracts.title: Redacted Operational Diagnostics, Incident Fingerprinting & Bounded Client Fetch
contracts.purpose: Captures server, worker, and rate-limited untrusted client operational failures with strict PII/token redaction, release SHA attribution, incident-group deduplication, and bounded client fetch timeouts.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Validates ALLOWED_FEATURE_KEYS, ALLOWED_SEVERITIES, ALLOWED_OUTCOMES, and SAFE_CONTEXT_KEYS; strips emails, phone numbers, bearer tokens, query strings, and file paths.
contracts.outputs: Correlation ID (corr_<hex>) in X-Correlation-Id and error envelopes; grouped incidents with release relationship in /api/admin/diagnostics*.
contracts.errors: POST /api/diagnostics/report is non-recursive and rate-limited (429 when exceeded) and never resolves or refreshes session cookies.
contracts.side_effects: Upserts diagnostic_incident_groups and inserts diagnostic_events using isolated error-absorbing DB connection.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Admin: Mod sees non-Top feature keys with coarse actor state; Admin: Top sees full redacted incident groups and executes triage/synthetic-test/cleanup.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: fetchJsonBounded marks timed-out mutating requests as uncertainWrite=true so callers do not blindly auto-retry non-idempotent writes.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Every new feature domain must register its diagnostic featureKey in ALLOWED_FEATURE_KEYS in lib/diagnostics.js.
contracts.known_limitations: Intentional 503 maintenance/paused responses are excluded from server error incident creation to prevent false alert storms.

contracts.title: Unified Sonoma Discovery Catalog, Pacific Live/Schedule Precedence & Card Rendering
contracts.purpose: Merges PostgreSQL vendors, owner_profiles, truck_settings, and owner_schedule with curated Sonoma baseline metadata, evaluates Pacific Time live/scheduled windows, serves ETag-cached /api/trucks*, and renders compact horizontal cards.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Filters out inactive, hidden_from_discovery, or active temp-restricted vendors via isVendorPubliclyDiscoverable; enforces photo_rights_basis ('owner_confirmed' | 'admin_verified') before emitting external photo URLs.
contracts.outputs: GET /api/trucks returns { trucks, directoryPlaces, meta, evaluatedCatalogVersion } with public Cache-Control + ETag.
contracts.errors: 404 on unknown/hidden truck ID; 403/503 on /api/trucks/availability when event_inquiries is hidden.
contracts.side_effects: Read-only public catalog queries; never reads session cookies or emits Set-Cookie on /api/trucks.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Public read for discoverable listings; self-elevation fields (verified, photo_rights_basis) are blocked on vendor profile writes via findForbiddenSelfElevationField.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Deterministic Pacific Time window evaluation and ETag computation.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Card media slot and badge rules are owned by public/app.js#cardHTML and public/color-calm.css without unverified external food photos.
contracts.known_limitations: Legacy /api/catalog/* and /api/schedule/today endpoints have zero public/ callers but are retained for 30-route parity.

contracts.title: Account-Backed Customer Exploration: Stories, Visit Journal, Badges, Challenges, Trails & Legacy Import
contracts.purpose: Provides public sourced editorial stories and suggested trails alongside strictly account-backed (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY) customer visit check-ins, derived points/levels/badges, Monday-Sunday Pacific weekly challenges, saved itineraries, one-time legacy device import, and self-service privacy export/deletion.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Never accepts client user_id; binds verifiedUser.id + setUserRlsContextInTx(app.user_id). Validates discoverable vendor_id on new visits, max 1 visit per (user_id, vendor_id, visited_on_pacific) calendar day, 280-char sanitized private_note, 2-4 deduplicated trail stops, and optional idempotency_key.
contracts.outputs: Structured { ok: true, ... } payloads with Pacific week bounds, derived achievements (5 badge definitions, non-monetary points/levels), saved trail stop progress, and complete JSON export.
contracts.errors: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED on anonymous /api/me/*, 409 VISIT_ALREADY_LOGGED_TODAY (with existing_visit), 400 INVALID_VENDOR_ID / TRAIL_STOPS_INVALID, 503 FEATURE_PAUSED, 403 FEATURE_DISABLED.
contracts.side_effects: Persists RLS-isolated rows in PostgreSQL; client clears memory cache on account switch/sign-out and prunes legacy localStorage/IndexedDB entries ONLY after confirmed per-item server persistence.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: GET /api/stories and GET /api/trails/suggest are public; all /api/me/* routes require 14+-eligible authenticated session and owner-only RLS; /api/me/exploration/export and /api/me/*/delete remain available even when features are paused/hidden.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Unique indexes on (user_id, idempotency_key) and (user_id, vendor_id, visited_on_pacific) prevent duplicate visits or duplicate saved trails under retry/double-submit.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Points, levels, badges, and weekly challenges must remain derived projections over customer_visits and customer_photos so disabling presentation never corrupts underlying records.
contracts.known_limitations: Visits are explicitly labeled self-reported check-ins (no background GPS tracking).

contracts.title: Private Confined Photo Derivatives, EXIF Stripping & Orphan Reconciliation
contracts.purpose: Validates uploaded JPEG/PNG/WebP magic bytes (<= 5 MB, <= 24 MP), re-encodes display and thumb WebP derivatives via sharp to strip EXIF/GPS metadata, stores files outside public/ under BITESHARK_PHOTO_STORAGE_DIR, serves owner-authenticated downloads with nosniff/no-store headers, and reconciles orphan files/rows.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Rejects SVG/GIF/HTML, MIME/magic-byte mismatches, > 5 MiB raw bytes, > 8000px per side or > 24 MP, path traversal, symlinks outside realpath root, and insufficient free disk space (BITESHARK_PHOTO_MIN_FREE_BYTES).
contracts.outputs: Metadata DTOs on /api/me/photos (never exposing host filesystem paths) and binary image/webp stream on GET /api/me/photos/file with Cache-Control: private, no-store, Content-Security-Policy: sandbox, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
contracts.errors: 400 UNSUPPORTED_PHOTO_FORMAT / PHOTO_MIME_MISMATCH / CORRUPT_PHOTO_DATA, 413 PHOTO_TOO_LARGE, 404 PHOTO_NOT_FOUND (for non-owners or deleted photos), 507 PHOTO_STORAGE_LOW_SPACE.
contracts.side_effects: Writes 0600 files inside 0700 user shard directories under BITESHARK_PHOTO_STORAGE_DIR; cleans up newly written files if DB commit fails; reconcilePhotoStorage purges orphan files beyond grace window and marks missing-file rows storage_missing.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Strictly private to uploading user (visibility = 'private' CHECK constraint + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY); never served as public static files.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Deduplicates retries by (user_id, idempotency_key) before writing duplicate derivatives.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Deployment releases must never place BITESHARK_PHOTO_STORAGE_DIR inside ephemeral release directories (/srv/*/releases/*) or public/.
contracts.known_limitations: Public/community photo sharing is intentionally unsupported in this contract.

contracts.title: Support & Feedback Tickets, Sharing Scope & Connected Incident Links
contracts.purpose: Manages human-readable BS-001xxx support/feedback tickets, personal vs vendor_service sharing scopes, reporter/staff notes, append-only timeline events, and many-to-many diagnostic_incident_groups links.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Validates category, reporter_urgency, sharing_scope (forbidding vendor_service on customer or account_access tickets), sanitized correlation/release context, and idempotency_key.
contracts.outputs: Reporter-redacted ticket timelines on /api/issues* (never exposing internal staff notes or raw incident internals); full triage view on /api/admin/issues*.
contracts.errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 unauthorized ticket/vendor scope, 400 invalid state transition or missing resolution note.
contracts.side_effects: Appends support_issue_events (REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE), links incidents, and dispatches bounded Resend notifications when configured.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Unassessed accounts may use /api/issues* ONLY for privacy, accessibility, or account_access categories; internal notes and suggested diagnostic links are hidden from reporters.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Deduplicates ticket and reply submissions by idempotency_key and locks support_issues FOR UPDATE on status/assignment transitions.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Internal triage metadata must never leak into serializeSupportTicketForReporter.
contracts.known_limitations: Email notifications degrade gracefully to in-app unread badges when email delivery is disabled.

contracts.title: Pickup Pagers, Web Push Subscriptions & Lease-Fenced Outbox Worker
contracts.purpose: Creates vendor pickup pagers, manages RFC 8291 encrypted Web Push subscriptions with capability/unsubscribe tokens, and dispatches ready notifications via a lease-fenced background worker with pre-send rechecks.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: Validates HTTPS Web Push endpoint allowlist, ECDH P-256 keys, X-BiteShark-Client: web-pager-v1 CSRF header, UUID request_key idempotency on staff pager creation, and loopback + timing-safe worker bearer secret on /api/pager/worker.
contracts.outputs: Redacted guest pager status on /api/pager/status; vendor queue on /api/pager/staff; Top-admin outbox metrics on /api/pager/telemetry.
contracts.errors: 403 loopback/CSRF/feature-disabled rejections, 401 invalid worker secret, 503 write-pause or disabled push provider.
contracts.side_effects: Claims delivery leases with fencing tokens, re-verifies feature control and active pager state immediately before external HTTPS push send, and records worker heartbeats.
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Vendor Staff/Owner/Admin on /api/pager/staff & /update; capability UUID on /status & /subscriptions; loopback supervisor + secret on /worker; Admin: Top only on /telemetry.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED wave claiming + monotonic lease fencing tokens prevent double-send races across worker restarts.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: DELETE /api/pager/subscriptions (guest unsubscribe) must remain exempt when pager_push_subscriptions is paused or hidden.
contracts.known_limitations: Real Web Push delivery requires VAPID keys and BITESHARK_PUSH_PROVIDER_MODE=webpush.

contracts.title: Immutable SQL Migration Checksums, Release Tarball Packaging & Atomic Staging Installer
contracts.purpose: Verifies SHA-256 checksums of applied migrations/001..NNN.sql, enforces NOBYPASSRLS + table-level REVOKE privileges on the runtime DB role, builds clean Git release tarballs, and atomically switches /srv/*/current with automatic healthz/worker rollback.
contracts.inputs_and_validation: run-migrations.cjs aborts on any SHA-256 mismatch against schema_migrations; build-linux-release-tarball.cjs honors .gitattributes export-ignore (excluding tests/, dev-server.cjs, .env*); install-staging-release.sh verifies tarball SHA-256, flock lock, and post-switch /api/healthz release_sha.
contracts.outputs: Deterministic release tarball + .sha256 manifest; /api/healthz returns { status: 'ok', release_sha, registered_routes: 30 }.
contracts.errors: Nonzero exit and automatic symlink + systemd rollback in deploy/install-staging-release.sh if migration, service restart, healthz SHA check, or worker journal check fails.
contracts.side_effects: Applies forward-only additive SQL migrations, updates /srv/*/current symlink, restarts truckly-staging / truckly-pager-worker (or staging2 units via biteshark-staging2-ctl).
contracts.permissions_and_ownership: Primary staging (/srv/truckly-staging, port 4100) and secondary staging2 (/srv/biteshark-staging2, port 4102) have strictly isolated Linux users, DBs, env files, photo roots, and systemd units.
contracts.idempotency_and_concurrency: Already-applied migrations with matching SHA-256 are skipped idempotently; concurrent deploys are blocked via flock.
contracts.compatibility_expectations: Applied SQL migrations are immutable and additive-only so symlink rollback to the previous release remains compatible with the database schema.
contracts.known_limitations: Symlink rollback reverts code and restarts services; it never runs destructive DOWN SQL against persistent staging/production data.
